# omada_ssids (Data Source)

Lists SSIDs in one WLAN group for discovery and import.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omada_ssids" "all" {
  wlan_group_id = data.omada_wlan_group.default.id
}

output "ssids" {
  value = data.omada_ssids.all.ssids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `wlan_group_id` (String) WLAN group ID.

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `ssids` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssids))

<a id="nestedatt--ssids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssids`

Read-Only:

- `band` (Number)
- `broadcast` (Boolean)
- `guest` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `security` (Number)
- `vlan_enable` (Boolean)
- `vlan_id` (Number)
